visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt and white pleated skirt, walks away from the camera on a paved outdoor walkway at night. A male hand reaches into the frame from the right. (2) The woman turns around sharply, revealing wireless white earbuds and a surprised facial expression with wide eyes. She holds a smartphone in her left hand and begins speaking excitedly, gesticulating with her right hand. The background is a large glass arena entrance with the text 'GATE 1' visible. (3) The scene cuts to a dark concert stage interior where a male singer in a long black coat performs under bright blue and white laser lights. Large video screens in the background display close-ups of the performance while colorful confetti drifts through the air. (4) Back outside the arena, the woman continues her conversation, smiling and looking slightly sheepish. She turns and runs away from the camera toward the entrance gates. (5) Inside the venue, the woman and a female friend are seen in a medium shot, both holding glowing white light sticks and laughing while singing along passionately. The lighting is dominated by high-contrast stage beams and the glow from the audience's light sticks. (6) A close-up on the large stage screen shows the male singer speaking into a microphone. The camera pans across a massive crowd in the dark stadium, all holding illuminated devices. (7) The woman is shown again in a tight shot, singing with closed eyes and high emotional intensity, holding the light stick close to her chin. (8) Two pairs of hands are shown in the foreground with pink and white manicured nails, held up against the backdrop of the brightly lit stage and the cheering crowd.

A female voice responds with high arousal and excited pitch variability, claiming she is listening to Mayday. The background is a quiet urban night atmosphere. (2) There is a sharp transition to high-energy live concert audio. A professional male singing voice (Mayday's Ashin) dominates the mix, accompanied by a driving rock rhythm with a clear drum kit and electric guitar texture. The tempo is approximately 128 BPM. (3) The audio cuts back to the outdoor dialogue. The female voice speaks rapidly with a comedic inflection. A subtle whoosh sound effect marks a transition. (4) The mix returns to the concert, featuring high-volume crowd noise with cheering and singing. The female creator's voice is heard singing along enthusiastically, blending with the live BGM and the roar of thousands of fans. (5) The singer's voice shifts to speech, asking the crowd a question with an authoritative yet playful tone. The crowd responds with a synchronized, massive yell of 'Dui!' (Yes), creating a high spectral peak. (6) The final phase is dominated by a sentimental pop ballad track with emotional piano and soaring vocals, capturing a collective singing-along experience with high harmonic clarity.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Event Experience -> Emotional Climax
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous skit about a fan being interrupted while listening to music as a creative 'hook' to transition into a high-energy montage of a Mayday concert. Its objective is to share the excitement, emotional depth, and immersive atmosphere of the live performance, catering to the band's fan base.
